held.title: Queries are now interpolated twice, so ad-hoc filters and variable values can be applied a second time.
held.body:
`runSplitQuery` now calls `datasource.applyTemplateVariables(query, request.scopedVars, request.filters)` on every target. The split sub-requests still go through `datasource.runQuery`, and if that still ends in `DataSourceWithBackend.query`, it calls `applyTemplateVariables` on each target again with the same `request.filters`.

What can go wrong on the second pass:
- Loki's `applyTemplateVariables` adds the ad-hoc filters to `expr`, so a query with ad-hoc filters can get them twice, for example as duplicate matchers or duplicate `| key="value"` stages.
- A variable value that contains `$name` text gets interpolated again.

I could not see `runQuery` or `applyTemplateVariables` here, so I can't confirm the second call. If it happens, mark the targets as already interpolated, or skip interpolation in `runQuery` for split sub-requests. You could also interpolate only the variables that splitting needs and leave ad-hoc filters to the backend path.
